changelog: The battery ring and the power figures on the Device list and the Device monitor now come from one live device reading, merged in one place. Entering a page no longer shows the slower cloud figure first and replaces it a moment later: the last reading is kept across screens, and a device with nothing to show yet waits rather than showing a number it is about to take back. A reply too short to carry the battery level is rejected rather than read as 0%.
